attributes.action: Do not introduce a mandatory social media curfew for 16- and 17-year-olds
attributes.background:
We want the Government to avoid introducing a mandatory overnight social media curfew for 16 & 17 year olds. 
This being implemented takes away simple HUMAN RIGHTS, such as freedom. 
If a 16/17yo is old enough to vote, we can take care of our phone usage.

rejection.details: You may wish to sign this petition, which calls for similar action: "Do not introduce social media curfew for 16 & 17 year olds" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/772675
